title: Add inline Queue scan launch recovery
summary: Add an inline Scan Queue recovery action to scan-recoverable normal Queue launch preflight alerts.
reason: The backend correctly requires an accepted Queue dry-run before normal Run Once, but the startup alert only describes the failure and forces the operator to navigate elsewhere to perform the stated recovery.
behavior_before: A scan-recoverable normal Queue preflight blocker renders guidance text without an inline action.
behavior_after: A scan-recoverable normal Queue preflight blocker offers an accessible inline Scan Queue action that reuses the existing backend Queue scan workflow, exposes submission state, and keeps unrelated blockers action-free.
tests_added: Focused launch preflight smoke covers recovery visibility, exact existing Queue scan delegation, pending state, success state, and suppression for unrelated blockers.
manual_validation: targeted refresh_summaries for three touched source/test files - passed
git diff --check for task-owned source/test files - passed
rollback_plan: Remove the startup-alert Queue scan recovery helper and dependency wiring, restore the Queue scan function's prior no-return behavior, remove the focused styling, and revert the focused smoke assertions.
notes: No Python implementation impact. The action calls the existing plan-only /api/queue/scan workflow; it does not change backend launch policy, media processing, source mutation, or filesystem policy. Representative real-media validation is not required for this WebView-only recovery affordance.
